title: a16z Podcast: Monetizing Open Source (Or, All Enterprise Software)

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Here’s what we know about open source: Developers are the new buyers.
reader_summary.overview: Here’s what we know about open source: Developers are the new buyers. And there will never be another Red Hat (i.e., a successful “open core” business model … nor do we necessarily think there should be). Yet open source is real, and it’s here to stay.

key_points.text: So how then do companies build a viable business model on top of open source?
And not only make money, but become a huge business, like the IBMs, Microsofts, Oracles, and SAPs of the world?
